note: Laws in force on 1 January 2000 (gameplay classification). social_market_economy: a post-transition market economy with a sizeable state-owned sector. managed_trade: Poland was not yet inside the EU single market (it joined the EU in 2004, after the 2003 referendum). universal_conscription: compulsory military service was still in force. fossil_first: electricity came overwhelmingly from coal. pluralist_secularism: a constitutionally secular state with a strongly Catholic society. These classifications should be reviewed against sources in Pass B.
